sermon.title: The Apostles Were Sent to Encourage Morality in the the World
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows the apostles sent to make disciples and preach repentance worldwide: protecting children unlike Ahaz, obeying God over corrupt councils, judging incest in Corinth, confronting Athens’ idols, scattering under persecution, and warning from Revelation 21:8 who ends in the lake of fire.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Sexual immorality/incest church discipline, bribery (Felix), idolatry, lake of fire list kept as spoken. Slug retains doubled “the” from catalog.

faqs.question: Is a disciple more than someone who only believes?
faqs.answer: Make disciples means a follower, not just a person that believes in Christ.

faqs.question: Should children see parents pray?
faqs.answer: At Tyre the kids saw dad kneeling on the shore—modeling prayer in the family.

faqs.question: Did Felix want a bribe from Paul?
faqs.answer: He hoped Paul would pay to be released; Paul would not follow the bribe.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Meanwhile he also hoped that money would be given him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore he sent for him more often and conversed with him.

faqs.question: Should believers obey God or men when ordered to be silent?
faqs.answer: Peter and the apostles: we ought to obey God rather than men.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But Peter and the other apostles answered and said: “We ought to obey God rather than men.

faqs.question: Can the church ignore open incest among members?
faqs.answer: Paul says he will judge it—put that man out; this is wrong.

faqs.question: Should people’s opinions rule the church?
faqs.answer: A real church rejects the people’s own ways and follows God’s word.

faqs.question: Does God dwell in church buildings?
faqs.answer: Paul: he doesn’t dwell in temples made by hands; people are his temple.

faqs.question: Why could the apostles stay in Jerusalem during persecution?
faqs.answer: He says God protected them there but scattered the rest so the church would spread.

faqs.question: What point does he make about the gates of hell?
faqs.answer: Jesus builds his church and gates of hell shall not prevail; requirements to get through those gates matter—authority to go into hell’s territory with the gospel.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.

faqs.question: Is occult practice listed with sexual immorality among the damned?
faqs.answer: Revelation 21:8 lists sorcerers/witchcraft/occult with sexually immoral, idolaters and liars in the lake of fire.
